title: Bullets Block Hub
description: A block that can connect all of your chests, furnaces and more together! Say goodbye to spamming right click between your block entities!
body:
This mod brings you the block hub block that lets you create an access point to neighbouring block entities. Gone are the days you need to move your mouse and press right click trying to find the right chest. Gone are the days you need to go back and fourth the crafting table and chest. You have everything under your finger tips.
![the ui of the block hub](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be8b4d7c3b893931ee891d6ec4dce03a124cb82d_0.webp)

Pless the A or D key to go right or left, or just click the block you want to interact with!
Soon I will enable item transfer for your automations! Stay tuned.
